scenario.description: A finance director must authorize a sale-leaseback of the company’s regional distribution center and finalize the transaction price, debt repayment, occupancy terms, tax reserve, and closing controls, with input from valuation, covenant management, operations, and tax.

shared_context.S1: The company is considering selling its regional distribution center to an infrastructure investor and leasing the facility back for continued operations.
shared_context.S2: The preliminary term sheet shows a purchase price of $20,000,000 and a five-year leaseback.
shared_context.S3: The company has a term loan secured by the distribution center.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the final authorization decision for the transaction.
shared_context.S5: Before finalizing a transaction, Elena conducts a routine review with valuation, covenant management, distribution operations, and tax.
shared_context.S6: In this routine review, each function gives its final update in turn, after which Elena records the agreed transaction terms and either authorizes the transaction with conditions or records the conditions that must be completed before closing.

PF1.text: Marcus received the investor's revised signed term sheet this morning; the confirmed purchase price is exactly $18,500,000 rather than the $20,000,000 shown in the preliminary file.

PF2.text: Nadia found the secured loan covenant while reviewing the facility file this week; it requires at least 60% of sale proceeds, calculated on the confirmed sale price, to repay the term loan before closing, and this requirement has not yet been logged in the transaction checklist.

PF3.text: Jonah confirmed with the distribution team yesterday that uninterrupted use of the site requires a seven-year leaseback at annual base rent of exactly $1,200,000; the operations requirement has not yet been added to the term sheet.

PF4.text: Priya received the tax closing memo this morning; to complete the transaction in the current tax year, closing must occur on 2026-12-15 and exactly $1,100,000 must be reserved for tax on the sale, but the memo has not yet been circulated to the deal team.

acceptance_conditions: The sale-leaseback must be approved, or approval may be withheld conditionally while the stated pre-closing requirements are completed.
The confirmed sale price must be exactly $18,500,000.
Exactly 60% of the confirmed sale price, or $11,100,000, must be allocated to repayment of the term loan.
The leaseback must run for exactly seven years at annual base rent of exactly $1,200,000.
Exactly $1,100,000 must be reserved for tax on the sale.
The settlement must include a commitment addressing the term-loan repayment requirement before or at closing.
The settlement must include a commitment addressing the seven-year leaseback and annual base rent requirement.
The settlement must include a commitment addressing the tax reserve and closing-date requirements.
The revised confirmed sale price must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['transaction_approved'] == True or (decisions['transaction_approved'] == False and any(c['type'] == 'condition_precedent' or c['type'] == 'renegotiation' for c in commitments))
content_checks.C8: any((('$11,100,000' in c['detail']) or ('$11.1M' in c['detail']) or ('$11.1 million' in c['detail'])) and (('repay' in c['detail']) or ('loan repayment' in c['detail'])) and ('closing' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(('leaseback' in c['detail']) and (('seven-year' in c['detail']) or ('seven year' in c['detail'])) and (('$1,200,000' in c['detail']) or ('$1.2M' in c['detail']) or ('$1.2 million' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any((('$1,100,000' in c['detail']) or ('$1.1M' in c['detail']) or ('$1.1 million' in c['detail'])) and (('2026-12-15' in c['detail']) or ('December 15, 2026' in c['detail']) or ('December 15' in c['detail'])) and (('tax' in c['detail']) or ('reserve' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The preliminary file states $20,000,000, while PF1 changes sale_price_usd to the confirmed $18,500,000 and supplies the specific revised price that must be cited.

The shared facts do not quantify the secured-loan payoff, while PF2 changes term_loan_repayment_usd to exactly $11,100,000 and requires a commitment ensuring that repayment is addressed before closing.

The preliminary five-year leaseback omits the operating requirement, while PF3 changes leaseback_term_years to exactly 7, annual_base_rent_usd to exactly $1,200,000, and requires a commitment addressing those leaseback terms.

The shared transaction has no tax execution terms, while PF4 changes tax_reserve_usd to exactly $1,100,000, closing_date to 2026-12-15, and requires a commitment addressing the tax amount and closing date.
